scope: Frozen detector-proxy stress amplitudes; no measured hardware-systematic interpretation

paired_digitizer_sample.selection: lowest deterministic accepted-family hash within each class

variants.name: heldout_pattern
variants.role: fixed spatial failure pattern absent from fitting; not used to choose model or thresholds

noise_definition: Pixel fake channels sampled over all native hardware addresses; bar Poisson PE over all 96 panels and 40 bars/panel, including initially unobserved channels. Fake PE has zero independent edep proxy.
gain_definition: Common multiplicative scale on bar edep and PE proxies before threshold; no inferred ADC calibration
alignment_definition: Measurement-coordinate and supplied-geometry bias, without changing material transport or acceptance
tracker_definition: Resolution re-digitizes saved ideal float32 crossings with identical nominal RNG; inefficiency thins nominal accepted measurements using common additional randomness

transport.scope: Actual G4 resimulation at fixed input particles and vertices; density changes preserve geometry. Helicity amplitudes are diagnostic proxies.

generator.matching: incoming signed flavour, energy, tungsten isotope and common benchmark vertex support; report overlap/Neff; independent generator events
generator.NuWro: no compatible readable input found; not measured

unsupported_inputs.time_window_and_time_resolution: No measured timing in current observation schema

conditional_metrics: Nominal calibrated probability mapping and validation thresholds remain fixed in every condition
